task.title: Toast action buttons are under the 44px touch standard on mobile
task.description: Filed from the P6-031 review (2026-08-10). The Android probe measured the teardown toast's Undo action at 44x24 px; the repo's own touch standard is TAP = 44 (android-tap-targets-check.mjs), and specs/app-ui.md's '24px is comfortably tappable' claim conflicts with it. This affects EVERY sonner toast action on the phone — including the undo affordances the deletion chain made mobile's only recovery path (delete undo, teardown undo, removal undo). Fix in the sonner component's action styling (min-height / padding to reach 44px effective target per the standard), reconcile the spec claim, and re-run the tap-targets probe. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-components.md.
